comparator.name: Medicine
comparator.sourceNotes: Current provisional first and second years are retained as 60+60 EC. Parent packages are counted once; zero-credit submodules and the exchange-only AWV variant are not stacked. Required Mechanisms of Disease 1 and 2 are English-medium while Dutch remains the main programme language, supporting normalized NLD+ENG. The product says the new third-year programme will follow; outgoing third-year courses and the historical distributed endpoint are not attached to this cohort.
